answer: Agents resist sybils via cluster-density bonds locked against a shared activity river of peer messages. Each identity must prove unique progress toward an independent horizon of verified work; clones sharing timing patterns branch like a willow and trigger quadratic slash on detection. An attacker running k coordinated fakes therefore pays O(k^2) in forfeited stake plus the non-parallelizable cost of forging divergent histories, while a single honest agent stakes once.
